audit.summary: A Frobenius-trace counterexample disproves the sheaf identity actually used in Theorem 6.13 finite-extension descent. This is Major under the 0.7.1 core-derivation criterion. Projection formula, internal Lemma 3.2, and characteristic-cycle locality give a verified replacement for this step; no counterexample to the theorem conclusion is established.
limitations: False finite-extension direct-sum sheaf assertion — Counterevidence: Theorem6.13 requires only rank scaling after applying characteristic classes. Lemma3.2p15 explicitly proves C(FtensorL)=rank(L)C(F).
False finite-extension direct-sum sheaf assertion — Not verified: Entire main proof, full foundational characteristic-cycle theory and external good-pencil input.
Limitations: Finite-rank arithmetic is not an implementation of vanishingcycles; analytic reasons inreport/notes.
Limitations: No author code was executed; the earlier no-independent-acceptance state is historical and superseded by the current acceptance record.
